This page documents the '''new items''' added by the [[Skyrim:Nix-Hound|Nix-Hound]] [[Skyrim:Creation Club|Creation]].

==Food==

===Raw Food===

The Creation takes care to add the raw Nix-Hound Meat to [[SR:Survival Mode|Survival Mode]]'s raw food table, so you can contract [[Skyrim:Disease#Food Poisoning|Food Poisoning]] by consuming the uncooked variant.
